title: Cone
description: JSON Schema for a cone over a diagram — an object N together with a family of morphisms (legs) n_j : N → D(j) for each j in the index category, such that for every morphism f : j → j' in the index category, D(f) ∘ n_j = n_{j'} (Mac Lane 1971 Ch. III §3). Cones are the candidate solutions for limits; the limit is the universal cone.

apex.description: The cone's apex object N — the object from which all the legs emanate.

over-diagram.description: The diagram D : J → C this cone is over.

legs.description: The leg morphisms n_j : N → D(j), one per object of the index category. Commutativity of the leg-with-diagram squares is a transformer-level check.
